newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran to receive third Russian-made submarine.
newsitem.headline: Iran to receive third Russian-made submarine.

text.p: Iran will take delivery of its third Russian-made Kilo-class submarine within six months, an Iranian navy commander said on Sunday.

"The third Russian-made submarine purchased by Iran will join the Iranian navy within the next six months," the official Iranian news agency IRNA quoted deputy commander of the Iranian navy Rear Admiral Mohammad Hussein Shafi'i as saying.
Analysts in the region say the United States and Iran's Gulf Arab neighbours are watching to see when Iran will deploy the third submarine and are concerned about Iran's armament programme.
Iran is the only regional state to operate submarines in the region which has about 70 percent of the world's oil reserves. The oil is largely transported by sea.
